shared_elements: stone relief panel with figural subject
carved/incised depiction of persons in profile or frontal stance
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures on a rectangular stone panel, but that is the extent of the correspondence: A is a single large, naturalistically modelled bust in profile with elaborately curled beard, hair and headdress rendered in high relief, while B is a flat, schematic multi-figure scene of silhouetted robed persons in two stacked registers framed by an interlace border. There is no shared motif, no shared relationship between figures, and no shared compositional scheme; the conventions of rendering (volumetric profile portrait vs. outline-and-silhouette crowd scene) are utterly different.
